comment:
* Helper for accessing API features in
 * {@link android.view.ViewGroup.MarginLayoutParams MarginLayoutParams} added after API 4.

methods.name: public static int getMarginStart(ViewGroup.MarginLayoutParams lp)
methods.comment:
* Get the relative starting margin that was set. * *

On platform versions supporting bidirectional text and layouts * this value will be resolved into the LayoutParams object's left or right * margin as appropriate when the associated View is attached to a window * or when the layout direction of that view changes.

* * @param lp LayoutParams to query * @return the margin along the starting edge in pixels

methods.name: public static int getMarginEnd(ViewGroup.MarginLayoutParams lp)
methods.comment:
* Get the relative ending margin that was set. * *

On platform versions supporting bidirectional text and layouts * this value will be resolved into the LayoutParams object's left or right * margin as appropriate when the associated View is attached to a window * or when the layout direction of that view changes.

* * @param lp LayoutParams to query * @return the margin along the ending edge in pixels

methods.name: public static void setMarginStart(ViewGroup.MarginLayoutParams lp, int marginStart)
methods.comment:
* Set the relative start margin. * *

On platform versions supporting bidirectional text and layouts * this value will be resolved into the LayoutParams object's left or right * margin as appropriate when the associated View is attached to a window * or when the layout direction of that view changes.

* * @param lp LayoutParams to query * @param marginStart the desired start margin in pixels

methods.name: public static void setMarginEnd(ViewGroup.MarginLayoutParams lp, int marginEnd)
methods.comment:
* Set the relative end margin. * *

On platform versions supporting bidirectional text and layouts * this value will be resolved into the LayoutParams object's left or right * margin as appropriate when the associated View is attached to a window * or when the layout direction of that view changes.

* * @param lp LayoutParams to query * @param marginEnd the desired end margin in pixels

methods.name: public static boolean isMarginRelative(ViewGroup.MarginLayoutParams lp)
methods.comment:
* Check if margins are relative.
     *
     * @return true if either marginStart or marginEnd has been set.

methods.name: public static int getLayoutDirection(ViewGroup.MarginLayoutParams lp)
methods.comment:
* Returns the layout direction. Can be either {@link ViewCompat#LAYOUT_DIRECTION_LTR} or
     * {@link ViewCompat#LAYOUT_DIRECTION_RTL}.
     *
     * @return the layout direction.

methods.name: public static void setLayoutDirection(ViewGroup.MarginLayoutParams lp, int layoutDirection)
methods.comment:
* Set the layout direction.
     *
     * @param layoutDirection the layout direction.
     *        Should be either {@link ViewCompat#LAYOUT_DIRECTION_LTR}
     *                     or {@link ViewCompat#LAYOUT_DIRECTION_RTL}.

methods.name: public static void resolveLayoutDirection(ViewGroup.MarginLayoutParams lp, int layoutDirection)
methods.comment:
* This will be called by {@link android.view.View#requestLayout()}. Left and Right margins
     * may be overridden depending on layout direction.
